content.text: glucocorticoids hasten defervescence and relieve pharyngitis but generally should ⍉be used in uncomp dz; they can help w comp such as impending airway obstruct, severe thrombocytopenia and hemolytic anemia.
Contraindicated in systemic fungal infect. ⍉live vax @ immunosuppressive doses. Caution: HF, HTN, renal insuff; peptic ulcer, diverticulitis (perf risk).

CYP3A4 inducers (phenytoin, carbamazepine, RIF, barbiturates) may require a higher steroid dose; inhibitors (ketoconazole, itraconazole, ritonavir, erythromycin) raise levels. NSAIDs/ASA: ↑ GI SE. Warfarin: response USU inhibited; monitor INR often. K-depleting diuretics: watch for hypokalemia.
Don't stop abruptly; taper after prolonged use (AI risk for up to 12 mo). Tell other clinicians you take steroids; seek care promptly for fever or infect.
